body: Hi! My son is 11 and wants to start saxophone. Do you have beginner spots for fall, and do you provide the instrument or do we rent one?
Welcome, Rebecca. Yes, we have beginner saxophone openings for fall. We don't sell instruments, but I'll send a short rental list we trust. Want me to hold a Tuesday 4pm slot while you decide?
Yes please hold the Tuesday slot. One more thing — is there a scholarship option? Money is a little tight this year.
I saw the youth ensemble on your Instagram. My daughter is 9 — is that too young, and does it meet on Saturdays?
Nine is a great age to start. The youth ensemble meets Saturday mornings, but for a first year I'd suggest a private lesson first, then ensemble in the spring. Happy to set up a trial lesson.
Dante's drum kit needs new heads before the recital.
Hi — I'm with the Westport Neighborhood Association. We'd love to help promote your scholarship recital and maybe sponsor a seat or two. Who handles that?
That means a lot, Derek. We co-host the recital with KC Youth Arts Collective. I'll send the sponsor sheet this week — even covering one student's year makes a real difference.
Hello! I'm looking into lessons for my son. He's never played before. Would you start him in a group class or private lessons?

For a true beginner I usually recommend private lessons for the first semester so he builds tone and reading, then group class once he's comfortable. We can mix both if budget allows. Want me to send the rate sheet?
